name: Legionary

bonuses.name: Architect of Ruin
bonuses.text: The GM gains 1 point of Ruin at the start of each of this Threat's turns.

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 1 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Mark of Chaos
bonuses.text: This Threat has a Mark of Chaos (W&G p.136)

bonuses.name: Space Marine Implants
bonuses.text: Gain bonus dice and options for actions from Space Marine Implants (W&G p.75)

abilities.text: They are also armed with Frag and Krak Grenades.

abilities.name: Veteran of the Long War
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to add the game's Tier as ED to all attacks this Threat makes this Round

options.name: Aspiring Champion
options.text: An Aspiring Champion leads a band of Legionaries. They have the following additional wargear and Ruin action.

abilities.name: Death to the False Emperor!
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to Charge, gaining +2 bonus dice to the attack Test.

options.name: Havocs (p.34)
options.text: Havocs are the Heretic Astartes equivalent of Devastator squads. Havocs may carry reaper autocannons, lascannons, heavy bolters, missile launchers, or reaper chain cannons. A Havoc Champion may be armed with flamer, meltagun or plasma gun, and chainsword. A Havoc Champion replaces their RUIN action with the following.

abilities.name: Annihilation!
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. Heavy weapon attacks made by Havocs within 6m gain the Brutal trait for 1 round.

note: Printed with an 'Or,' between Chainsword and Boltgun: a Legionary carries one or the other. Closest Core block is chaos-space-marine (different name and stats). The Havocs sidebar (p.34) sits on the page before and names no block; attached here as a variant.
